race.title: Bet On The Best Night Out At Dundalk Stadium Maiden
race.verdict: LOOKINGFORARAINBOW isn't especially progressive but looks a pretty solid option here on the back of her recent C&D second. Resurgence has to shrug off a below-par effort but the overall balance of his form would give him a major shout, with Joseph O'Brien's newcomer Queen Creek also meriting respect. LOOKINGFORARAINBOW (USA) RESURGENCE (IRE) QUEEN CREEK (IRE)
